metas.name: 2026 · Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
metas.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2019 · Wayne
metas.description: Wayne, a 16-year-old with a heart of gold, sets out on a small two-stroke road bike from Boston to Florida with his new friend Del to retrieve the '79 Trans-Am that was stolen from his father before he died.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1966 · It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Intern
metas.description: A story about what happens when  Seon-wu, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2015 · The Little Prince
metas.description: A little girl lives in a very grown-up world with her mother, who tries to prepare her for it. Her neighbor, the Aviator, introduces the girl to an extraordinary world where anything is possible, the world of the Little Prince.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2021 · The Loud House Movie
metas.description: With his parents and all 10 sisters in tow, Lincoln Loud heads to Scotland and learns that royalty runs in the family in this global musical journey.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Udta Teer
metas.description: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

metas.name: ★ 2.4 · 2026 · Money Trap: The Karun Treasure
metas.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

metas.name: 2026 · Masterplan
metas.description: A master thief enlists two strangers for a Louvre heist targeting the Mona Lisa, then reveals they're his children and siblings who must cooperate to pull off history's greatest art theft.

metas.name: 2026 · The Incomer
metas.description: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.

metas.name: ★ 9.4 · 2026 · Wanted
metas.description: Hyun-jun, an ordinary postman, is mistakenly arrested as a wanted criminal due to his identical appearance to fugitive Choi Cheol-gu. While struggling to prove his innocence, the real Cheol-gu escapes prison and flees to Taiwan. When Hyun-jun travels there on a reward trip, he is once again mistaken for the criminal and even kidnapped, only to be rescued by tough detective Woo-hee and her partner. As repeated mix-ups lead to comedic chaos, Hyun-jun and Woo-hee grow closer and ultimately team up to catch the real fugitive together.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · The Informant
metas.description: Tae-bong, an informant in a smuggling operation, gets exposed during his mission. Meanwhile, bumbling detective Nam-hyuk stumbles into the chaos while attempting his own scheme. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two must recover their losses and take down the criminals.

metas.name: 2026 · Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.
